title: Romantic Bali Honeymoon with Nusa Penida
alt: Angel's Billabong rock pool on Nusa Penida, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the road to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Ubud Monkey Forest
activities.description: Banyan trees, moss covered shrines and a few hundred macaques in a sanctuary ten minutes on foot from the Ubud market.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland to begin, with the crater lake at Kintamani, a coffee plantation stop and the rice terraces at Tegalalang.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Uluwatu and Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Water sports, Padang Padang and Uluwatu
activities.match: Water Sports with Uluwatu Temple Tour
activities.description: Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa, the cove at Padang Padang beach, then Uluwatu temple above the surf for sunset.

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast by speedboat
activities.description: Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach, the island's four best known stops.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you, warm oil and long pressure strokes, booked privately at a spa near your hotel.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the south coast, with water sports and Uluwatu, a full day on Nusa Penida and a spa afternoon before you fly home.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud resort and settle in
First evening free among the rice fields
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to the coast
Water sports at Tanjung Benoa: banana boat and jet ski
Padang Padang beach, then Uluwatu temple for sunset
Check in at your Kuta hotel for three nights
4: Early breakfast, then private transfer to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Return boat to Bali and back to your hotel
5: Breakfast and a slow morning by the pool
A traditional Balinese massage for two at a nearby spa
Optional: a sunset dinner cruise from Benoa harbour
Optional: the Kuta night market or dinner on the beach
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Keep Nusa Penida for the middle of the trip. It is the big day out, and you want the spa after it.
expert.tip: The Kelingking viewpoint has a steep path down and most couples stop at the top, which is the better photograph anyway. Flat shoes, water and an early boat make the day easy.

summary: Six days for two, with two nights in Ubud for the crater lake at Kintamani and the rice terraces, then three on the coast with water sports, Uluwatu at sunset, a full day on Nusa Penida and a couples massage.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace tour; water sports with Padang Padang and Uluwatu; Nusa Penida west coast tour; Balinese massage for two; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
